info.title: MacroTracker server API
info.description: REST API for the MacroTracker app, web app and agents. MCP is served separately at /mcp.

bearer.description: A session access token from /v1/auth/login, or a personal access token (mt_pat_…).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Apps send `refresh_token` in the body. Browsers send nothing in the body: the httpOnly cookie is used, and the `x-csrf-token` header must match the `mt_csrf` cookie.

post.summary: Redeem an invite or password-reset link and set a password
Change password; signs out every other device

get.summary: Devices signed in to my account

delete.description: Its access token stops working at once and its refresh token is refused.

post.summary: Create a personal access token (for MCP and agents)
post.description: The token is returned once; only its hash is kept.
Creates the account and returns an invite link for the admin to pass on. No email is sent.
Also works for someone whose invite expired.

delete.summary: Delete an account and all its data

get.summary: Account and server identity, current rev
get.description: Called when the app connects, to decide between uploading its data, merging, or replacing it.

post.description: Each change gets its own result. Retrying a change id is harmless. Stale and duplicate results carry the row's current server state.

row.description: The row as the app stores it (snake_case columns); see packages/shared/src/sync/rows.ts.

get.description: Returns the current state of each row changed after `since`, in rev order. 409 `cursor_ahead` means the server is behind the app (restored from a backup); pull again from 0.

post.summary: Upload an app's existing data on first connect
post.description: Adds rows the server doesn't have; rows it already has (or has deleted) keep the server's version. Send in batches, then pull from 0.

row.description: The row as the app stores it (snake_case columns); see packages/shared/src/sync/rows.ts.

get.summary: A day's diary, totals and targets

post.summary: Log a food, a recipe or quick-add macros
post.description: Macros are snapshotted from the food or recipe now; later edits to the food never change this entry.

patch.summary: Change an entry (amount, time, day, or quick-add macros)

Your profile (null until set up in the app)

post.summary: Accept this week's check-in: new targets from today
Share one of your recipes (or update the shared copy)
post.description: Every ingredient must be on the server: your synced foods or USDA foods. Recipes with INDB foods can’t be shared.

get.summary: A shared recipe with its ingredients

delete.summary: Remove a recipe from the library (yours, or any as an admin)
delete.description: Copies people already added stay theirs.

post.summary: Add a shared recipe to your recipes
post.description: Creates your own copy (and foods for its ingredients; USDA ones are reused). It syncs to your phones. Later changes by its owner don’t change your copy.

delete.summary: Disconnect an app (its tokens stop working at once)
